# Data dictionary

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs:reference`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Three layers: **platform tables** in schema `core` (fixed, versioned migrations in `db/migrations`), **tenant canonical tables** in schema `t_<tenant>` (generated from that tenant's contract), and **read-only views** in `reporting` and `t_<tenant>.rpt_*` / `current_*`.

## Migration history

| Migration | Applied | Checksum |
|---|---|---|
| 0001_core.sql | 2026-10-20 | `b900972405558a85…` |
| 0002_review_hardening.sql | 2026-10-20 | `194358b67e16f02b…` |
| 0003_query_workspace.sql | 2026-10-20 | `d031b1be1999c7e9…` |
| 0004_saved_analytics.sql | 2026-10-20 | `45737303184230b8…` |
| 0005_assistant_tool_calls.sql | 2026-10-20 | `08dcc5ac230648a9…` |

Tenant storage changes are not platform migrations: they are contract migrations, planned and recorded in `core.contract_migrations` (see docs/contracts.md).

## Reporting views (`reporting`)

Readable by tenant reporting roles; row-level security limits every row to the role's tenant.

- **reporting.batch_overview**: tenant_id, batch_id, source_id, entity, contract_version, transform_version, arrival_at, source_reported_at, is_late, pipeline_status, attempt_count, received_count, accepted_count, quarantined_count, duplicate_count, late_record_count, correction_count, conflict_count, quality_status, reconciliation_status, trust_status, started_at, completed_at, end_to_end_seconds
- **reporting.exceptions**: tenant_id, batch_id, source_id, entity, record_key, category, status, source_row, errors, created_at
- **reporting.quality_overview**: tenant_id, batch_id, source_id, rule_id, rule_kind, category, severity, evaluated_count, failed_count, contract_version, attempt, created_at
- **reporting.reconciliation_overview**: tenant_id, batch_id, scope, check_id, status, expected, actual, difference, explanation, run_id, created_at

## System columns on every canonical table

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| _record_id | Surrogate id of this record version. |
| _key | Canonical entity key (key fields joined). |
| _record_hash | SHA-256 of the canonical values; identifies exact duplicates. |
| _is_current | True for the one current version per key. |
| _is_late | Version arrived after a newer one and is kept as history only. |
| _batch_id | Batch that produced the version. |
| _raw_record_id | Source row that produced it (null for migration-created versions). |
| _contract_version_id | Contract version under which it was produced. |
| _transform_version | Transform engine + contract hash (or migration#id). |
| _loaded_at | When the version was written. |
| _migration_id | Migration that created this version, if any. |
| _supersedes_record_id | Prior version replaced by a migration-created version. |

Each entity also gets three views: `current_<entity>` (all fields, current versions), `rpt_<entity>` (non-sensitive fields, current versions) and `rpt_trusted_<entity>` (non-sensitive fields, latest version from a trusted batch per key: the same rule as trusted metrics). The `rpt_` views are granted to the tenant reporting role and carry `_trust_status`.

## Canonical model: northwind (contract 1.0.0)

Northwind Health Plan: medical plan administrator. Members, benefit plans, medical claims (adjudicated with sequence numbers) and pharmacy fills.

### plan

Benefit plan reference data. Key: `plan_code`. Corrections: `supersede_by_order` by `updated_at`. Freshness limit 720 h.

| Field | Type | Required | Nullable | Sensitivity | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| plan_code | string | yes | no | public | format alnum; max 12 chars |  |
| plan_name | string | yes | no | public | max 120 chars |  |
| plan_type | enum | yes | no | public | one of HMO, PPO, EPO, HDHP |  |
| deductible | decimal(10,2) | yes | no | public | min 0 |  |
| oop_max | decimal(10,2) | yes | no | public | min 0 |  |
| effective_date | date | yes | no | public |  |  |
| termination_date | date | no | yes | public |  |  |
| updated_at | timestamp | yes | no | internal |  |  |

Rules:
- `oop_covers_deductible` (error): Out-of-pocket maximum must be at least the deductible
- `plan_dates_ordered` (error): Termination date must not precede effective date

### member

Member eligibility (one current version per member). Key: `member_id`. Corrections: `supersede_by_order` by `updated_at`. Freshness limit 26 h.

| Field | Type | Required | Nullable | Sensitivity | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| member_id | string | yes | no | internal | format alnum; max 15 chars | Synthetic member identifier |
| ssn | string | no | yes | pii | max 11 chars | Synthetic SSN (900-series, never valid) |
| first_name | string | yes | no | pii | max 60 chars |  |
| last_name | string | yes | no | pii | max 60 chars |  |
